text:
maria (billing): FYI invoice INV-8421 (Acme Health) auto-collect failed: initial card decline, then ACH attempt failed — microdeposit not confirmed.
ops-bot: Payment alert: INV-8421 failed card -> attempted ACH on 03/20 pending microdeposit. See /invoices/INV-8421
maria (billing): Customer replied: "I set up ACH but numbers didn't match, says 'account verification failed'". They asked for wire instructions as backup.
ajay (cs): Can we send a manual payment link + retry? Customer is blocked from deploying model dev env.
nora (payments): We can do a one-time manual retry but need customer permission in writing and to avoid storing CC. ACH microdeposit mismatch usually means wrong routing or acct type (savings vs checking).
samir (accounting): If we do a manual ACH push we need CFO approval for exception to automated retry window. Otherwise wire is fastest.
maria (billing): @zack (legal) tagging for approval language — if we send wire instructions we need to include bank details + terms.
zack (legal): Send wire with standard wording. Don't include sensitive internal routing notes. Also need confirmation that amount equals invoice total + wire fee? We should waive small bank fee this once. :+1:
nora (payments): Proposed plan:
- Send customer an ACH troubleshooting checklist (routing #, account type, microdeposit timing)
- After customer confirms, allow up to 2 manual ACH retries spaced 24h apart
- If they prefer immediate resolution, send wire instructions and mark invoice as "pending-wire"
- Flag for accounting to record manual collection method
maria (billing): Here's the payment link curl (one-time link) if we need it:
```
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-8421/payment_link \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" \
  -d '{"expires_in":3600,"method":"card"}'
```
ajay (cs): Customer said they'd prefer wire. They asked for wiring details now.
maria (billing): @samir can you provide wire instructions and confirm we waive the fee?
samir (accounting): Wire details attached below (internal). Will waive up to $25 fee; anything over we bill.
ops-bot: Note created on invoice INV-8421: "Wire instructions sent; fee waiver approved by accounting" (ticket #AC-1123)
maria (billing): Sending wire info to customer now. Also adding note to ledger and will mark invoice with attempt timestamps.
zack (legal): Also add: "Payment will be considered received when funds are confirmed in our account. Invoice terms unchanged."
ajay (cs): Customer confirmed receipt of instructions and provided expected wiring date (tomorrow). I'll set a calendar follow-up.
maria (billing): Closing loop here — once funds posted, we'll update invoice status and release any holds. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Invoice INV-8421 status updated to pending-wire at 1802510196
